text:
Miriam K: quick design callout 1: added a new prototype for prompt-set compare + approval modal. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz. Goals: make regressions discoverable, simplify CTA copy, and ensure keyboard/screen-reader flow. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/zzz

Devin R: looks good overall. two concerns: the diff deletion red is low contrast on our bg, and focus outlines are missing on diff rows. will add color swatches + focus styles in figma comments.

Ash Patel: accessibility notes: make each diff row a semantic button (aria-expanded + aria-controls). add a visually-hidden summary for each row like "Regression: Test X down 12%". include an aria-live region for new diffs but debounce updates.

Miriam K: modal copy draft:
Heading: Approve prompt set
Body: "This will promote the prompt set to selected model variants. Add optional reviewer notes. Rollout will be gradual."
Primary visual: "Approve & Promote" (compact label: "Promote"), Secondary: "Request changes", Inline: "Approve with notes" expand.

Sam O'Neill: PM ask: move a condensed scorecard into the modal header (pass % / regressions). also add keyboard shortcuts: A=Promote, R=Request changes, N=Notes. show shortcut hints in the modal footer.

DesignBot: regression-bot: alert for prompt-set 142: 3 regressions, avg delta -10%. report: https://dash/reports/142

Devin R: for copy, i prefer primary visual to read "Approve & Promote" but button label attribute should be short for screen readers and keyboard users ("Promote"). tooltip can show full text. CSS snippet for focus I'll add: `.diff-row:focus { outline: 3px solid #005fcc; outline-offset: 2px; }`

Ash Patel: ARIA snippet for modal: `<div role\="dialog\" aria-labelledby\="approve-heading\" aria-describedby\="scorecard-summary\">` ensure the expand control uses aria-expanded and aria-controls. the inline notes expansion must not trap focus and should be reachable with 'N'.

Miriam K: decisions: (1) replace deletion red with two higher-contrast hex options from Devin; (2) show condensed scorecard in modal header; (3) keep visual CTA as "Approve & Promote" but use compact label "Promote" for shortcuts; (4) inline notes via expandable region under CTA with accessible keyboard mapping; (5) diff rows focusable and announced.

Sam O'Neill: i'll add acceptance criteria to INF-1170: color contrast check, focus visible, keyboard shortcuts (A/R/N), scorecard placement, inline notes accessibility. will also request top-3 failing examples from data for modal preview. ticket: https://jira/redwood/browse/INF-1170

Devin R: i'll post color swatches + token PR. Sam: can you confirm which model variants to show in the modal for the prototype?

Sam O'Neill: prototype show the defaults (gpt-like-small, gpt-like-medium). i'll add details to the ticket.

Ash Patel: i'll draft QA script for screen reader + keyboard walkthrough and share in the ticket.

Miriam K: action items: @Devin R - colors + focus CSS; @Ash Patel - ARIA + QA script; @Sam O'Neill - ticket + data examples; @Miriam K - update figma and push prototype. target: interactive staging by next Tue. :thumbsup:

DesignBot: deploy-bot: staging canary scheduled 2026-04-03T05:00:00Z

Devin R: noted, will iterate on the gutter layout as well.

Sam O'Neill: thanks team, will sync tomorrow 11am PT.
